name: Meine Liebe II ~Hokori to Seigi to Ai~
original_name: マイネリーベII ~誇りと正義と愛~
source:
The year is 1937, the place, a European island country, the Kingdom of Kuchen.
The protagonist transfers into the high class boarding school, Rosenstolz Academy.
But with the shadow of war approaching, maybe more than just a normal school life will be awaiting her.
translation:
时间是1937年，地点是欧洲岛国库亨王国。
主人公转入高级寄宿学校罗森斯托尔兹学园。
然而，战争的阴影正在逼近，等待她的或许远不只是普通校园生活。
